title: primulina rotundifolia
intro: Primulina rotundifolia, commonly known as the Round-leaf Primulina, is a type of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Primulina rotundifolia include its immunomodulatory and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its ability to boost the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in the treatment of various diseases.
